description: v2.1.0 section 11 — the first Definition Layer object that produces a legal effect. Doctrines are the only place stage_effect (DEFEAT/MODIFY/EXEMPT) is attached at definition time; everything upstream of this (GroundFactDef/LegalElementDef/ElementBundleDef) is pure fact/evaluation with no legal consequence of its own.

stage.description: Must match effect.stage's legal target. 'elements' is excluded here (section 12.1) — a doctrine cannot attach at the Elements stage, only defeat/modify/exempt what comes after it.

requires.description: Section 11's self_defense example shows a flat list (current_unlawful_attack, defensive_act, proportionality) — the implicit-ALL degenerate case of this grammar, same convention as ElementBundleDef.requires.
